description: A quantum mechanical model of binocular rivalry by Efstratios Manousakis, resting on the quantum Zeno effect, gives good fits to the complex empirical data on rivalry (as reported by Stapp).
limitations: Reported secondhand in Stapp 2007. The fit does not show that a classical model cannot fit the same data.

sources.quote: has recently given a quantum mechanical description of the phenomena of binocular rivalry that fits the complex empirical data very well
